scope: patch the client's peer address to loopback and retest

conclusions.the_patch_was_overwritten: our write succeeded (verified byte-identical immediately after), yet a later status read shows 0.0.0.0:0 again, so the client re-derives or rewrites that field
conclusions.delivery_still_perfect: ring_b read == write == 10, so ten datagrams were consumed

what_this_means.address_filter_hypothesis: we could not keep the address patched long enough to test it; the client restores it, likely from the netchan state it built at connect time
what_this_means.more_important_signal: since delivery is complete and consumption is complete in every run, the blocker is inside the client's datagram-to-message path, not in transport or addressing
